desc.zh: 抛硬币走路的人平均哪儿也不去，却离起点越来越远，距离按步数的平方根长。从这一条出发，讲方差为什么相加、爱因斯坦和佩兰怎样用花粉旁的小颗粒数出分子、股价的几何布朗运动和年化波动率 σ√T、真实指数在哪里不像随机游走，再到赌徒破产、期权定价和 AI 扩散模型。八个可以动手的模型，只讲数学和证据，不是投资建议。
desc.en: A walker who flips a coin for every step goes nowhere on average, yet drifts ever further from the start, by the square root of the number of steps. From that one fact: why variances add, how Einstein and Perrin counted molecules from jiggling grains, geometric Brownian motion and annualised volatility σ√T, where a real index stops looking like a random walk, and on to gambler's ruin, option pricing and AI diffusion models. Eight hands-on models; mathematics and evidence only, not investment advice.

desc.zh: 抛硬币走 n 步，平均位置是 0，均方根距离是 √n；方差相加、标准差不相加，所以风险按时间的平方根增长。
desc.en: After n fair steps the mean position is 0 and the RMS distance is √n; variances add and standard deviations do not, so risk grows with the square root of time.

zh: 为什么波动随根号t增长
en: why volatility scales with square root of time

desc.zh: 随机游走的连续极限：爱因斯坦 1905 年的 ⟨x²⟩ = 2Dt、斯托克斯–爱因斯坦关系、扩散方程，佩兰由此数出阿伏伽德罗常数；巴舍利耶 1900 年把同样的数学用在价格上。
desc.en: The continuous limit of a random walk: Einstein's 1905 ⟨x²⟩ = 2Dt, the Stokes–Einstein relation and the diffusion equation, from which Perrin counted Avogadro's number; Bachelier used the same mathematics for prices in 1900.

zh: 爱因斯坦 布朗运动

title.zh: 肥尾与稳定分布：方差不够用的时候
title.en: Fat Tails and Stable Laws: When Variance Is Not Enough

desc.zh: 幂律尾巴的指数低于 2 时方差无穷、√t 规则和中心极限定理失效；纳斯达克日回报的尾部指数约为 3，峰度随期限加长而下降。
desc.en: With a power-law tail exponent below 2 the variance is infinite and the √t rule and the CLT break; NASDAQ daily returns have a tail exponent near 3, and kurtosis falls as the horizon grows.

en: are stock prices a random walk

desc.zh: 公平赌局走过距离 d 平均要 d² 局，成功概率是 i/N；不利的赌局里玩得越多越确定地输，大注少局反而更好。
desc.en: A fair walk needs d² steps on average to cover distance d and succeeds with probability i/N; in an unfavourable game more play means surer ruin, and bold play beats timid play.

title.zh: AI 扩散模型的加噪过程
title.en: The Noising Process of AI Diffusion Models

desc.zh: DDPM 的前向过程把数据一步步缩小、加噪，是一个固定的随机游走；生成靠神经网络学会反向去噪。
desc.en: The DDPM forward process shrinks the data and adds noise step by step, a fixed random walk; generation comes from a network that learns to reverse it.
